# Prompt 10 — Review Remediation (Parallel Edition)

## Goal

Apply every actionable finding from the 2026-05-25 review suite using **file-locked
workstreams** and a **merge train** on a long-lived integration branch — mirroring the
parallel dispatch pattern used for prompts 02+03+04.

**Sequential baseline (frozen):** [`v1.0.0.md`](v1.0.0.md) — do not edit.

**This edition adds:**
- [`parallel-manifest.md`](parallel-manifest.md) — DAG, file locks, branch names, merge order
- [`workstreams/`](workstreams/) — one self-contained agent brief per workstream (full mechanical specs)

## Execution overview

```
WS-0 (optional gate)
  → Wave 1: WS-1A..1G parallel (max 6) → WS-1H integrator (serial)
  → Wave 2: WS-2A → WS-2B serial on roster.py; WS-2C + WS-2D parallel
  → Wave 3: WS-3 audit unification (SERIAL — single agent)
  → Wave 4a: WS-4A + WS-4B parallel → WS-4C CLI split (serial)
  → Wave 5: WS-5A..5H parallel (5B before 5D; 5G before 5H on turnout.py)
  → Integration verify (full matrix)
```

**Integration branch:** `feature/review-remediation`

**Workstream branches:** `feature/review-remediation/ws-{id}` (see manifest)

## Coordinator role

One human or single **coordinator agent** owns:

1. Merging workstream branches onto `feature/review-remediation` in [merge train order](parallel-manifest.md#merge-train-order)
2. Running the [verification matrix](parallel-manifest.md#verification-matrix) after each wave
3. Resolving conflicts **only** in `cli.py` (WS-1H, WS-4C) and serializing `roster.py` (1B → 2A → 2B)
4. `AGENTS.md` bumps at wave end: **1.3.0** after WS-4C; **2.0.0** after WS-3 if audit schema ships without reader

See [Coordinator checklist](parallel-manifest.md#coordinator-checklist-after-each-wave).

## Pre-confirmed decisions (do not re-debate)

| Topic | Decision |
|-------|----------|
| Audit vocabulary | Writer superset: `multiple_counties`, `conflicting_method`, `multiple_dates`, `name_mismatch`, `precinct_mismatch`, `turnout_anomaly`, `missing_county` |
| Audit schema | `audit_schema_version: "2.0"` on new `audit_ev_*.json` |
| MCP contract tests | Owned by WS-1A (or WS-0 gate) only — `tests/unit/test_mcp_server.py` |
| ty strict (S1) | Out of scope until all waves green — track as prompt `11-ty-strict` |

## Strategic items (out of parallel waves)

S1–S6 from v1.0.0 remain separate follow-up prompts (`11-ty-strict`, `12-health-json`, etc.).
Link from coordinator handoff; do not fold into WS-5.
